title: Step 3b - Comparing 3 vs 5 Clusters in Hierarchical Clustering: Python Example

cues.en: Instructor: All right.
cues.zh: 講師：好。

cues.en: So remember that the cluster numbers don't go from one to five, but from zero to four because indexes and Python start from zero.
cues.zh: 記得群組編號不是 1 到 5，而是 0 到 4，因為 Python 的索引從 0 開始。

cues.en: So let's see, let's open this again.
cues.zh: 再打開這裡看看。

cues.en: What these numbers mean is that, well the first customer, customer id, number one belongs to the last cluster, you know, cluster number five.
cues.zh: 這些數字的意思是，第一位顧客，也就是顧客 ID 1，屬於最後一群，也就是第五群。

cues.en: Then the second customer belongs to cluster number four.
cues.zh: 第二位顧客屬於第四群。

cues.en: Third customer belongs to cluster number five or cluster index four as you want.
cues.zh: 第三位顧客屬於第五群，也可以說索引 4 的群組。

cues.en: Then customer id number four belongs to cluster number four.
cues.zh: 顧客 ID 4 屬於第四群。

cues.en: All right, so this is how you should read it.
cues.zh: 這就是解讀方式。

cues.en: And the last customer and this dataset, you know, the customer actually number 200 this one of age 30, and earning a high salary
cues.zh: 資料集最後一位，也就是顧客 200，這位 30 歲、收入高，

cues.en: and spending a lot actually in the mall belongs to the third cluster or cluster of index two.
cues.zh: 而且在購物中心花很多的顧客，屬於第三群，也就是索引 2 的群組。

cues.en: All right, so that's how you should read it.
cues.zh: 這就是解讀方式。

cues.en: And now, now let's visualize the final clusters.
cues.zh: 現在把最終群組視覺化。

cues.en: You know, now that we have this dependent variable that we just created through the hierarchical clustering process.
cues.zh: 因為已經透過階層式分群流程，建立了這個應變數。

cues.en: And so there you go. I'm going to close this.
cues.zh: 把這裡關掉。

cues.en: We're gonna run that cell to indeed find, actually you know, the same clusters as with kmeans
cues.zh: 執行這個儲存格，實際上會找到與 K-means 相同的群組。

cues.en: with remember this cluster representing the customers that earn a low salary and don't spend much in the mall and therefore we should just not target them too much
cues.zh: 記得這一群代表薪資低，而且在購物中心消費不多的顧客，因此不該過度向他們推銷，

cues.en: because we want to be socially responsible and don't push them to consume too much, right?
cues.zh: 因為我們要承擔社會責任，不要推動他們過度消費，對吧？

cues.en: However, this cluster is the cluster of the customers having a high annual income but a low spending score.
cues.zh: 這個群組則是年收入高，消費分數低的顧客。

cues.en: And therefore we want to target these customers to offer them some more attractive deals in order to incentivize them to spend more in the mall because otherwise the mall is missing out.
cues.zh: 因此想鎖定他們，提供更有吸引力的優惠，鼓勵他們在購物中心多消費，否則購物中心就錯失機會。

cues.en: Then this cluster is the cluster of customers having a low annual income, but a high spending score.
cues.zh: 這個群組是年收入低，消費分數卻高的顧客。

cues.en: And therefore with these customers, you know, you want to be the maximum socially responsible and maybe protect them from spending too much and potentially more than they could afford.
cues.zh: 對這些人，應該盡可能負起社會責任，或許保護他們，避免花太多，甚至超出負擔能力。

cues.en: So to these customers, we for example, want to reduce any kind of advertising, then we have this cluster which is the best cluster, you know, the one we want to target the most
cues.zh: 例如減少對他們的各種廣告。接著這個是最理想的群組，也是最想鎖定的群組，

cues.en: because it is the cluster of the customers having a high annual income and at the same time spending a lot.
cues.zh: 因為這群顧客年收入高，而且消費也很多。

cues.en: So we definitely want to target these customers to you know, offer them the new products, the new deals because we know that we have a high chance to have a high conversion rates with them. Alright?
cues.zh: 所以肯定想鎖定他們，提供新產品、新優惠，因為知道很可能獲得很高的轉換率，好嗎？

cues.en: And then we have this cluster, which is the average cluster, you know, average annual income and average spending score.
cues.zh: 然後這個是中等群組，年收入中等，消費分數也中等。

cues.en: And for this cluster, well, we don't have much specific to do, alright?
cues.zh: 對這群人，沒有太多特別要做的事，好嗎？

cues.en: So these are the same five clusters, as with Kmeans but now I'm very curious to see what we get with three clusters.
cues.zh: 這和 K-means 得到的是相同的五群，但我現在很好奇分成三群會得到什麼。

cues.en: And therefore what we're gonna do is try now n_clusters equal three here, but then be careful.
cues.zh: 因此，現在試著把這裡設成 n_clusters = 3，但要小心。

cues.en: We need to actually remove two lines here when you know, visualizing the clusters because each scatter plot here corresponds to one cluster and therefore now since we're about to have
cues.zh: 把群組視覺化時，必須移除這裡兩行，因為每個 scatter 都對應一群；現在只會有

cues.en: three clusters, well, we need to remove two clusters here.
cues.zh: 三個群組，所以得移除兩群。

cues.en: So we're gonna remove cluster four and cluster five.
cues.zh: 移除第四群和第五群。

cues.en: All right?
cues.zh: 好嗎？

cues.en: And therefore we're just gonna end up with you know, cluster one, cluster two and cluster three of colors, red, blue, and green.
cues.zh: 最後只剩第一、第二和第三群，顏色是紅、藍、綠。

cues.en: All right, so let's just run this again.
cues.zh: 好，再執行一次。

cues.en: You know we can leave the previous cells and just rerun this one to indeed get a new hierarchical clustering model, this time identifying three clusters.
cues.zh: 前面的儲存格可以保留，只重新執行這個，取得新的階層式分群模型，這次辨識三個群組。

cues.en: We can print this again in order to get the new dependent variable with this time indeed, three clusters, the cluster of index zero which seems to contain most of the first customers.
cues.zh: 可以再次列印，取得新的應變數，這次確實有三群；索引 0 的群組，看來包含前面大部分顧客。

cues.en: Then the cluster of index one, the second cluster and the cluster of index two, the third cluster. Okay?
cues.zh: 然後索引 1，也就是第二群，以及索引 2，也就是第三群，好嗎？

cues.en: And now I'm really curious to see what we get when visualizing the clusters.
cues.zh: 現在真的很好奇，把群組視覺化會看到什麼。

cues.en: So here we go, we just have to play the cell again and let's see what we get.
cues.zh: 再執行儲存格，來看看。

cues.en: Okay, so yeah, really five clusters was actually a better number because here with three clusters, well the model just put all these customers, you know
cues.zh: 好，看來五群其實比較好，因為三群時，模型把這些顧客，

cues.en: actually the low income customers with both a low spending score or high spending score into a same cluster, also taking the average one.
cues.zh: 也就是低收入且消費分數低或高的人，全放到同一群，連中等的也包括在內。

cues.en: And then we have these two other clusters the high spending score with the high annual income and the low spending score with the high annual income.
cues.zh: 另外兩群則是年收入高、消費分數高，以及年收入高、消費分數低。

cues.en: And you know, these still actually make some sense because remember that the clusters of customers that we really want to target after all
cues.zh: 其實這仍然有道理，因為記得我們真正想鎖定的顧客群，

cues.en: are this one and this one, and this, you know is something we don't really want to target but maybe protect, you know, you know as per our social responsibility.
cues.zh: 是這群和這群；這一群則不太想推銷，反而可能要保護，以承擔社會責任。

cues.en: So this actually still makes kind of sense and we indeed end up with the same focus of targeting these two important customers that can boost indeed the sales.
cues.zh: 所以這還是有些道理，最後重點仍然相同，就是鎖定能帶動銷售的這兩個重要客群。

cues.en: All right, so that was very interesting.
cues.zh: 好，非常有意思。

cues.en: I, I didn't expect actually to show you the result with three clusters.
cues.zh: 我原本其實沒打算示範三群的結果。

cues.en: I was just curious to see.
cues.zh: 只是好奇想看看。

cues.en: And that's very interesting because indeed we end up with kind of the same final marketing decisions of targeting our customers.
cues.zh: 這很有意思，因為最後針對顧客的行銷決策其實差不多。

cues.en: All right, so I hope you enjoyed clustering.
cues.zh: 好，希望你喜歡分群。

cues.zh: 接著進入下一部分，第五部分「關聯規則學習」。

cues.en: It's gonna be pretty exciting.
cues.zh: 會很精彩。

cues.en: We're gonna work on two new models, apriori and eclat.
cues.zh: 要處理兩個新模型：Apriori 和 Eclat。

cues.en: And so I will either meet you in this next part or if you want to learn R as well I will meet you in the next section to build the hierarchical clustering model in R.
cues.zh: 我們可以在下一部分見；如果你也想學 R，就在下一個單元見，一起用 R 建立階層式分群模型。

cues.en: And either way, I look forward to building another model with you.
cues.zh: 不論哪種，我都期待和你一起建立下一個模型。

cues.en: And until then, enjoy Machine Learning.
cues.zh: 在那之前，祝你享受機器學習的樂趣。
